success.description: M You assume the form of a bear. Place the Brown Bear Beastform card on your character sheet. You can only use the physical characteristics and skills shown on the card. While in beast form, you can only use spells with the Beastform trait. You resume human form when you are knocked unconscious or killed, or when the act ends or you voluntarily end the spell as a manoeuvre. In any case, this card will not recharge until the end of the act.

boon.description: You may perform a free manoeuvre as you change forms.

chaosStar.description: Your animal instincts take over. You add {Df} to all mental checks except Observation and Intuition while in beast form.

reckless.requirements: 7 power, must perform the prepare manoeuvre
